description:
Upgrade bathroom organization with a covered toilet paper holder that adds a built-in glass shelf and space-saving wall mount installation in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space. Crafted from solid brass and designed for the Waverly Place collection, this accessory helps keep essentials close at hand while the shelf provides a convenient spot for small items.

Highlights:
- Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Solid brass construction for enduring strength
- Wall mount design helps save floor space
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look

Specs:
- Collection: Waverly Place
- Style: Traditional

- Overall size: 8.75 in L x 6 in W x 4.6 in H (6 in projection)
- Weight: 5.6 lb
- Weight capacity: 250 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Toilet paper holder and all installation hardware (screws: #8 x 1 1/4)
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
Multiple designer finish options available
